lists.content:
• Support Application Mapping & Renewal Planning:

  • Assist in auditing existing software stacks to spot duplicate tools, redundancies, and integration opportunities.

  • Work closely with internal IT and business teams to prepare renewal schedules and contract rationalization roadmaps.

  • Vendor Engagement & Sourcing Support:

  • Participate in commercial negotiations and contract renewals with SaaS and software providers under the guidance of senior team members.

  • Review contract terms, benchmark market pricing, and assist in evaluating vendor proposals.

  • Synergy Tracking & Reporting:

  • Track cost optimization metrics, contractual milestones, and post-integration synergy targets.

  • Prepare dashboards, reports, and presentation materials for key stakeholders to maintain clear visibility on project milestones.

• Education: Currently pursuing a Master’s degree (Bac+4 / Bac+5) in Purchasing, Procurement, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or IT Management.

  • Foundational Knowledge: An initial grasp of SaaS commercial models, licensing metrics, and standard contractual clauses (or a strong appetite to learn them).

  • Interpersonal & Analytical Skills: Clear communication, analytical rigor with tools like Excel/Slides, and an interest in commercial negotiations.

  • Mindset: Proactive, structured, and comfortable working autonomously

  • Languages: Professional working proficiency in English

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.


Are you passionate about Customer Success excellence, data-driven retention strategies, and making global CS teams more efficient? If so, we are looking for a Customer Success Operations Analyst to join us.
In this role, you will be a key pillar of our Revenue Operations team, acting as a strategic Business Partner to our global CS team. You will contribute to the operational health of our customer base and drive continuous process improvement to protect and grow our recurring revenue. You will partner closely with both Senior GTM Ops, Customer Success management, and internal system stakeholders to keep our post-sales engine running at its best.

lists.content:
• Strategic Support: Support CSM regional managers and 1st line managers worldwide.

  • Data & Insights: Participate in Retention Forecasting, CSM Data Operations, and provide deep-dive portfolio management support.

  • Reporting & Analysis: Manage Reporting Requirements and perform Ad Hoc analysis to drive executive decision-making.

  • Lifecycle Management: Participate in Accounts Allocation, customer lifecycle tracking, and the monitoring of all Success KPIs.

  • Continuous Process Improvement: Review and improve Success processes to support global integration and scalability.

  • Operational Rhythm: Drive the leadership drumbeat by managing Meeting Agendas & Notes, as well as the preparation and resourcing for QBRs, All Hands, and Off-sites.

  • Systems & Communication: Liaise with the ISD (Internal Systems & Data) team to validate Tool Requirements, oversee Internal Communication, and ensure system workflows align with CS operational needs.

• Technical Proficiency: Intermediate experience with Salesforce (reporting, dashboards, and data architecture) and Gainsight (Success Plans, Playbooks, and Health Scoring).

  • Experience: 2-4 years of experience in CSM (Success) Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations within a SaaS environment.

  • Analytical Rigor: Exceptional attention to detail with a GTM business approach to data; you don’t just flag risks, you solve them at scale.

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for regional directors.

  • Project Management: Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Proactive Mindset: You are a self-starter who proactively identifies friction in the customer lifecycle and proposes scalable solutions.

lists.content:
• Provide dedicated operational guidance and business partner support to RVPs leading France and South EMEA, translating regional strategic priorities into actionable execution plans.

  • Own and manage the weekly commercial cadence, including pipeline reviews, forecasting routines, and performance checkpoints across assigned sales territories.

  • Drive CRM hygiene, stage discipline, and data accuracy within Salesforce and Clari to ensure high forecast predictability and pipeline visibility.

  • Act as the single point of contact for cross-regional project management and operational initiatives outside the local region, centralizing cross-regional execution rather than dividing tasks across regional field ops leads.

  • Proactively identify coverage gaps, sales velocity roadblocks, and performance risks, partnering with RevOps sub-functions to resolve issues before they impact targets.

  • Deliver field enablement and practical guidance on operational tools, process updates, and sales playbooks to foster strong process adoption among AEs and FLMs.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Strategy Ops, Deal Desk, Enablement, and Data Governance to align global process standards with field reality.

• 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations within a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.

  • Demonstrated success partnering with senior sales leadership (RVPs, VP-level) to drive pipeline execution, forecast discipline, and regional governance.

  • Proven ability to act as a centralized single point of contact for multi-regional projects, coordinating complex operational initiatives across global teams.

  • Advanced technical proficiency with Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, and documentation frameworks (Confluence).

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English. 

  • Fluent proficiency in French would be an asset but is not mandatory for this role.
